title: Candidate whose access window has lapsed is removed from the Completed Reviews tab in the BGV Vendor Portal

BGV Vendor Portal is accessible at <instance>/onboarding/onboarding/bgv

steps.action: Navigate to Settings > Flows > Onboarding > Advanced Settings > BGV Settings.
steps.expected: The BGV Settings section is visible, including the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' checkbox (default: unchecked) and the adjacent numeric input (default: 90, greyed out).

steps.action: Check the 'Remove candidate data access after verification completion' checkbox.
steps.expected: Checkbox becomes checked. The adjacent numeric input becomes editable (no longer greyed out).

steps.action: Clear the numeric input field and enter '30'.
steps.expected: The numeric input displays '30' with no inline validation error.

steps.action: Click Save.
steps.expected: Settings are saved successfully. A success notification appears. The checkbox remains checked and the numeric input retains the value '30'.

steps.expected: The Completed Reviews tab loads and displays a list of candidates with completed verifications.

steps.action: Search or scroll through the Completed Reviews tab listing for the candidate whose BGV completion date is 31+ days ago (i.e., current date > BGV completion date + 30 days).
steps.expected: The lapsed candidate does NOT appear anywhere in the Completed Reviews tab listing.

steps.action: Search or scroll through the Completed Reviews tab listing for the control candidate whose BGV completion date is within the last 30 days.
steps.expected: The control candidate (within access window) IS visible in the Completed Reviews tab listing.

expected_result: The candidate whose access window has lapsed is removed from the Completed Reviews tab listing, while candidates still within the access window remain visible.
assertions_summary: Lapsed candidate is absent from the Completed Reviews tab listing
Within-window candidate remains visible in the Completed Reviews tab listing
Setting is saved and persists with checkbox checked and value 30
